subject: general
question: According to the 205/55R16 specification, what is the tire width for the given tire size?
solution:
The correct answer is __205 mm.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 205__ indicates the width of the tire in millimeters.
 
• The width is measured from sidewall to sidewall.
 
• This measurement helps in determining the size and fitment of the tire for different vehicles.
 
• In this specification, 205 mm is the nominal width of the tire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tire Specifications:**

 
 
• The tire size is usually represented as a combination of numbers and letters.
 
• For example, in 205/55R16:
 
• 205 represents the width (in mm).
 
• 55 represents the aspect ratio (the ratio of the tire's height to its width).
 
• R indicates the radial construction of the tire.
 
• 16 refers to the diameter of the wheel (in inches).
 
 
 
• **Importance of Tire Width:**
 
 
• Wider tires provide better grip and handling on the road.
 
• Narrower tires are better for fuel efficiency and performance in certain conditions.
